arxiv-2102-08779.title: User Tracking in the Post-cookie Era: How Websites Bypass GDPR Consent to Track Users
arxiv-2102-08779.creator: Emmanouil Papadogiannakis, Panagiotis Papadopoulos, Nicolas Kourtellis, Evangelos P. Markatos
arxiv-2102-08779.description: Abstract . During the past few years, mostly as a result of the GDPR and the CCPA, websites have started to present users with cookie consent banners. These banners are web forms where the users can state their preference and declare which cookies they would like to accept, if such option exists.

arxiv-2105-09366.creator: Tathagata Pal, G. Worthey
arxiv-2105-09366.description: Abstract We investigate the frequency of occurrence of Galactic carbon stars as a function of progenitor mass using Gaia data. Small number statistics limit fidelity, but C star frequency agrees with that observed in the Magellanic Clouds (MCs) down to m ≈ 1.67 m\approx 1.67 M ⊙ . At m ≈ 1.38 m\approx 1.

arxiv-2109-14962.title: Embedding in MDS codes and Latin cubes The study was carried out within the framework of the state contract of the Sobolev Institute of Mathematics (project no. 0314-2019-0017).
arxiv-2109-14962.creator: Vladimir N. Potapov
arxiv-2109-14962.description: Abstract An embedding of a code is a mapping that preserves distances between codewords. We prove that any code with code distance ρ \rho and length d d can be embedded into an MDS code with the same code distance and length but under a larger alphabet.

arxiv-2112-10607.title: Number Rigidity of the Stochastic Airy Operator
arxiv-2112-10607.creator: Pierre Yves Gaudreau Lamarre, Promit Ghosal, Wenxuan Li, Yuchen Liao
arxiv-2112-10607.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pierre Yves Gaudreau Lamarre, Promit Ghosal, Wenxuan Li, Yuchen Liao. We prove that the spectrum of the stochastic Airy operator is rigid in the sense of Ghosh and Peres [ 22 ] for Dirichlet and Robin boundary conditions. This proves the rigidity of the Airy- β \beta point process and the soft-edge limit of rank- 1 1 perturbations of Gaussian β \beta -Ensembles for any β > 0 \beta>0 , and solves an open problem mentioned in [ 9 ] .

arxiv-2304-11210.title: Investigating the M G ​ C ​ S − M h M_{GCS}-M_{h} Relation in the Most Massive Galaxies DOLPHOT ( Dolphin 2000 ) , Astrodrizzle ( Hack et al. 2012 )
arxiv-2304-11210.creator: Veronika Dornan, William E. Harris
arxiv-2304-11210.description: Abstract The relation between the total mass contained in the globular clusters of a galaxy and the mass of its dark matter halo has been found observationally to be nearly linear over five decades of mass. However, the high-mass end of this relation is not well determined from previous data and shows large scatter.

arxiv-2311-16187.title: Modelling wildland fire burn severity in California using a spatial Super Learner approach
arxiv-2311-16187.creator: Nicholas Simafranca, Bryant Willoughby, Erin O’Neil, Sophie Farr, Brian J Reich, Naomi Giertych, Margaret Johnson, Madeleine Pascolini-Campbell
arxiv-2311-16187.description: Abstract Given the increasing prevalence of wildland fires in the Western US, there is a critical need to develop tools to understand and accurately predict burn severity. We develop a machine learning model to predict post-fire burn severity using pre-fire remotely sensed data.

arxiv-2402-18779.title: Nanoscale variation of the Rashba energy in BiTeI
arxiv-2402-18779.creator: Ruizhe Kang, Jian-Feng Ge, Yang He, Zhihuai Zhu, Daniel T. Larson, Mohammed Saghir, Jason D. Hoffman, Geetha Balakrishnan, Jennifer E. Hoffman
arxiv-2402-18779.description: Abstract BiTeI is a polar semiconductor with strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) that produces large Rashba spin splitting. Due to its potential utility in spintronics and magnetoelectrics, it is essential to understand how defects impact the spin transport in this material. Using scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, we image ring-like charging states of single-atom defects on the iodine surface of BiTeI.

arxiv-2407-04555.title: Traces of Hecke operators on Drinfeld modular forms for 𝔽 q ​ [ T ] \mathbb{F}_{q}[T]
arxiv-2407-04555.creator: Sjoerd de Vries

We deduce closed-form expressions for traces of Hecke operators corresponding to primes of degree at most 2 and provide algorithms for primes of higher degree.

pmc-10609027.title: Bioactivity and Metabolomic Profile of Extracts Derived from Mycelial Solid Cultures of Hypsizygus marmoreus
pmc-10609027.creator: Paola Angelini, Giancarlo Angeles Flores, Gaia Cusumano, Roberto Venanzoni, Roberto Maria Pellegrino, Gokhan Zengin, Simonetta Cristina Di Simone, Luigi Menghini, Claudio Ferrante
pmc-10609027.description: The beech mushroom (Hypsizygus marmoreus) is a highly nutritious, edible medicinal mushroom native to East Asia. The substrates tested included malt extract agar, malt extract agar enriched with barley malt, and malt extract agar enriched with grape pomace.

pmc-12373935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This paper presents the results from lapping experiments conducted with the use of a lapping plate fabricated by the selective laser sintering (SLS) from the polyamide PA2200 powder. The minimum quantity of diamond grains (grade D107) and paste (grade SD 28/20) were uniformly distributed on the active surface of a soft plate allowing for the effective material removal and a substantial improvement of the surface finish of Al2O3 ceramic samples.

pmc-12376442.title: From sequence to activity: the HgaI-homologous restriction modification system RM.MhoVI of Mycoplasma hominis
pmc-12376442.creator: Lars Vogelgsang, Manuel Dolgopolow-Schmidt, Azlan Nisar, Dana Bäcker, Alexander T. Dilthey, Birgit Henrich
pmc-12376442.description: Restriction-modification (RM) systems are widespread defense mechanisms in prokaryotes that protect the host from potentially harmful foreign DNA. They typically consist of a DNA methyltransferase (MTase), which methylates the host genome at an adenine (6 mA methylation) or cytosine (4mC or 5mC), and a restriction endonuclease (REase), which cleaves foreign, unmethylated DNA.

pmc-12704256.title: Comparison of community firearm violence news reports across four local television stations in Philadelphia, PA, USA: A quantitative media content analysis
pmc-12704256.creator: Siena Wanders, Jennifer Midberry, Anita Wamakima, Tyrone Muns, Kallie Palm, Jim MacMillan, Christopher N. Morrison, Jessica H. Beard
pmc-12704256.description: ObjectiveOn television news in Philadelphia, PA, USA, community firearm violence (CFV) is rarely covered as a public health issue, and harmful content elements are pervasive.
